title: Plant and Animal Reproduction
seo_title: Grade 8 Reproduction Worksheets: Animal Behaviors, Pollination, Seed Dispersal and Growth
standard_text: Use argument based on empirical evidence and scientific reasoning to support an explanation for how characteristic animal behaviors and specialized plant structures affect the probability of successful reproduction of animals and plants respectively.
meta_desc: Free middle school science worksheets on plant and animal reproduction (NGSS MS-LS1-4, MS-LS1-5): mating and parenting behaviors, pollination and seed dispersal, and how genes and the environment affect growth. 100 practice questions with answers.
key_big: Behaviors and structures help organisms reproduce.
key_sub: Mate displays, parental care, flowers and seed structures raise reproductive success. Genes and the environment both affect growth.
body_html:
How to think about it

Living things have behaviors and structures that raise the chance of successful reproduction:

  • Animal behaviors: attracting a mate (songs, displays, calls) and caring for young (building nests, guarding, feeding).
  • Plant structures: bright flowers and nectar attract pollinators; wings, hooks, fluff and fruit help with seed dispersal.

Growth depends on genes (the possible size) and the environment (light, water, food, temperature, space).

Example

Why do dandelion seeds have fluff?

Wind carries them.

Answer: for seed dispersal

Example

Same seeds, different light, different heights. Cause?

Genes are the same.

Answer: an environmental factor (light)

Common mistakes

  • Thinking flowers are colorful to look nice for people.
  • Thinking growth depends only on genes.
  • Thinking seeds spread without any help from wind, water or animals.

faq.q: How do animal behaviors help reproduction?
faq.a: Behaviors such as songs and displays attract mates, and behaviors such as nest building and guarding protect young so more survive.

faq.q: How do plant structures help reproduction?
faq.a: Bright flowers and nectar attract pollinators, and structures such as wings, hooks and fruit help spread seeds.

faq.q: What affects how big an organism grows?
faq.a: Its genes set the possible range, and environmental factors such as food, water, light and temperature affect how much it actually grows.

items.q: Which factors can affect how much a plant grows?
c: both genes and the environment (light, water, nutrients, temperature)
only the age of the gardener
only the color of the pot
items.e: Both matter.
